Elia Palatino is situated in Chania Town,100 metres from Municipal Art Gallery of Chania. Each room at this guest house is air conditioned and has a flat-screen TV. Enjoy a cup of coffee or tea while looking out at the sea or Chania Town. All rooms are equipped with a private bathroom. Extras include bathrobes and slippers. Elia Palatino features free WiFi . A Certified Greek Breakfast is served daily at Elia Fatma, only 20 meters away. Etz Hayyim Synagogue is 100 metres from Elia Palatino, while Maritime Museum Of Crete is 200 metres from the property. The nearest airport is Chania International Airport, 11 km from the property.

Solo travellers particularly like the location — they rated it 9.3 for a one-person stay.

Guest review summary
Automated summary based on 73 reviews from the past 12 months.
  • Location: Central setting in the pedestrian old town near the harbour, restaurants, and shops.
  • Breakfast: Served at a nearby sister property with a tasty variety of local options.
  • Views: Direct outlooks over the Venetian harbour, sea, and busy streets below.
  • Staff: Friendly and attentive team provide a warm welcome and assist with requests.
  • Stairs: Steep flights with no elevator make carrying luggage to upper floors difficult.

The fine print

Need-to-know information for guests at this property

Nearest public parking area is located at Talos Square.

Check in will take place at the main Reception of Elia Zampeliou Hotel, right next door.

Guests are required to show a photo identification and credit card upon check-in. Please note that all Special Requests are subject to availability and additional charges may apply.

Please inform Elia Palatino Hotel in advance of your expected arrival time. You can use the Special Requests box when booking, or contact the property directly with the contact details provided in your confirmation.

This property will not accommodate hen, stag or similar parties.

Quiet hours are between 23:00:00 and 09:00:00.
